existingHulmioInventory.name: OTP input
existingHulmioInventory.limit: A local code input. Code delivery and verification belong to your app.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Form
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Uses native form validation and submission events. Authentication and multi-step workflows belong to your app.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Date & time

examples.name: Date limits and native time fields

existingHulmioInventory.limit: Date and range controls use custom calendars. Time, date-time, month and week use native fields; explicit NativeDatePicker and NativeDateRangePicker alternatives remain available.

existingHulmioInventory.name: File upload
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Selects and validates local files. maxSize is bytes; upload transport and progress belong to your app.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Combobox
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Searchable custom autocomplete with keyboard selection; NativeCombobox retains the browser datalist alternative.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Multi-select
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Custom searchable multiple selection with removable chips. NativeMultiSelect retains the native HTML alternative.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Slider
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Single values or a two-value range, with min/max, step and keyboard controls. NativeSlider retains a native single-value input.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Data table
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Client-side sorting, filtering and pagination. Use stable row IDs; edits and selections refer to those IDs.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Chart
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Includes a readable data table. Scatter and heatmap use indexed categorical values; arbitrary x/y points and 2D matrices are outside this data contract.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Carousel
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Manual navigation. No automatic rotation.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Command palette
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Your app owns the open state and any global keyboard shortcut.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Toast
existingHulmioInventory.limit: A status notification surface. Your app controls its lifetime and notification queue.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Tooltip
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Use one ref-capable interactive child. Essential information belongs in persistent text.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Kanban board
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Move controls provide a keyboard-accessible workflow. Persistence and drag-and-drop integrations belong to your app.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Keyboard key
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Keyboard notation only. Register shortcut behavior in your app.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Alert dialog
existingHulmioInventory.limit: onConfirm is synchronous. Perform asynchronous deletion and handle errors in your app before closing a controlled dialog.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Hover card
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Nonessential preview content. Use Popover for interactive content and actions.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Calendar
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Public values are ISO YYYY-MM-DD strings. Pass valid date strings for values and bounds.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Range calendar
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Public values are { start, end } ISO date strings. App-specific booking rules belong in isDateUnavailable.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Clipboard
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Uses navigator.clipboard on a direct click. A secure context is required. Failure is announced locally and passed to onError.

existingHulmioInventory.name: Resizable
existingHulmioInventory.limit: Uses react-resizable-panels. Numbers are pixel sizes; percentage strings are relative sizes. Persistence belongs in the consuming app.

hulmioAdditionalCoverage.name: Field
requiredSections: Nested or grouped controls with explicit associations
